prerequisites.title: Box account with Developer Console access
prerequisites.detail: A free developer account or a Box enterprise account gives access to the Developer Console.

prerequisites.title: Contact for each customer's Box Admin
prerequisites.detail: Each customer's Admin or Co-Admin needs your Client ID to enable the app.

steps.title: Create a User-type app
steps.detail: Log into the Developer Console, select New App, choose User as the app type, then Create.
steps.done_when: App exists in the Developer Console

steps.title: Get the Composio redirect URI
steps.detail: Copy the redirect URI from the Composio dashboard.

steps.title: Register redirect URI and scopes
steps.detail: On the Configuration tab, add the redirect URI under OAuth 2.0 Redirect URI and choose scopes. The URI must be HTTPS or localhost HTTP.
steps.done_when: Redirect URI and scopes are saved

steps.title: Draft the minimal scope list
steps.detail: Draft a list of the smallest scopes the agent needs with a justification for each.

steps.title: Create Composio auth config
steps.detail: Create the Composio auth config for the box toolkit through Composio's API with your own client ID and secret.

steps.title: Send Client ID to customer admin
steps.detail: Copy the Client ID from OAuth 2.0 Credentials and submit it for admin approval; for enterprise developers, the Primary Admin gets an email.

steps.title: Admin enables the app
steps.detail: A Box Admin or Co-Admin adds the Client ID in the Admin Console under Platform Apps.
steps.done_when: App shows as enabled in Admin Console

steps.title: Connect a test account
steps.detail: Authorize through Composio and approve the consent screen, then check that the account can reach the files the agent needs.

traps.title: Cannot switch app type later
traps.detail: An OAuth 2.0 app cannot be changed to Server Authentication, nor the reverse. You would need a new app.

traps.title: Redirect URI must match exactly
traps.detail: A redirect_uri that does not match a configured URI fails. If several are configured and none is sent, users see redirect_uri_missing.

traps.title: Scope changes need re-authorization
traps.detail: Enterprise developers must resubmit to their Box Admin after saving changes.

traps.title: Users only reach files they can open
traps.detail: Scopes never grant access to files the user cannot open.

traps.title: API calls count toward customer allocation
traps.detail: Calls from custom apps count toward the enterprise's monthly API allocation, which may be a cost concern for customers.

blockers.symptom: App does not work for customer users after creation
blockers.what_it_means: Unpublished OAuth 2.0 apps may be inactive by default until a Box Admin or Co-Admin enables them.
blockers.what_to_do: Send the Client ID to the customer's admin to enable it in the Admin Console.
blockers.agent_can_help: Draft the message to the admin with the Client ID and steps.

blockers.what_it_means: Multiple redirect URIs are configured and the authorization URL did not include a redirect_uri.
blockers.what_to_do: Include a redirect_uri exactly matching one configured URI.
blockers.agent_can_help: Check the authorization URL against the configured URIs.
